timing_policy.primary_speedup: median of candidate.fps / baseline.fps for each AB/BA pair
timing_policy.reason: VSPipe prints elapsed seconds with fewer significant digits than FPS; use FPS from the same internal timer to avoid elapsed-time display quantization.
timing_policy.secondary: median of baseline.wall_seconds / candidate.wall_seconds per pair
timing_policy.selection: All five planned pairs; no filtering or choosing by speedup.
timing_policy.runner_summaries: Active runner and final report both use paired raw FPS ratios; attempt0 ended at VSPipe initialization before any performance samples.
timing_policy.environment_repair: Use the existing verified VSPipe runtime configuration; still reject unexpected dsmvc autoload and verify the exact mapped plugin path and hash.
